mathematical_definition: Raw pass-through of the input DataFrame's spread column (df['spread'].to_numpy(dtype=float64)); NaN if the column is absent
numerical_stability_notes: Constant for 98.89% of training history (spread_constant_frac=0.9889, measured 2026-08-19 via research/historical_coverage.py against data/gold_seed_merged_full6yr.csv). research/output/SUMMARY.md finding #9: zero CatBoost importance in the deployed model (never split on); removing it from the feature set costs exactly 0.0pp accuracy -- confirmed dead weight as a *feature* (separate from its potential use as a *cost* input)
missing_value_policy: NaN if the 'spread' column is absent from the input df, else the raw broker-reported value is passed through unmodified
